sources.name: Bioicons
sources.rights_notes: Use each license/author directory and authors.json, not the repository code license. Servier-attributed items remain held pending source-specific review.
sources.style_notes: Mixed contributors and styles; detailed artwork and simplified symbols are both present.

sources.name: Health Icons
sources.author: Resolve to Save Lives / Health Icons contributors
sources.rights_notes: Preserve item authorship, source, license and modifications; source inclusion is not item acceptance.
sources.style_notes: Outline and filled health pictograms, including 24px variants; suited to clinical and population workflows.

sources.name: Arcadia organism illustration library
sources.author: Arcadia Science
sources.rights_notes: The official v1.2 archive states all images are CC0. Preserve Arcadia Science credit and exact PhyloPic derivation/uploader notes from the official gallery. Scientific/common names enrich all styles; archive spelling variants are normalized only for metadata and grouping, never altering originals.
sources.style_notes: Organism silhouettes, tricolor-stroke SVG and transparent raster artwork. Species are separate from artwork variants.

sources.name: SciSVG
sources.author: Saveena Solanki / SciSVG contributors
sources.rights_notes: Artwork under assets/ is CC BY 4.0 unless a file says otherwise; code is MIT. Preserve per-item attribution from metadata.
sources.style_notes: Small collection of structured flat vectors for cell biology, laboratory methods and bioinformatics.

sources.name: KYU49 SVG Collection of Lab Equipment
sources.author: KYU49
sources.rights_notes: CC BY 4.0. The author additionally waives credit for specified scientific uses; this library still retains credit. Component/state files are variants, not independent equipment counts.
sources.style_notes: Technical illustrations of chemical and biochemical apparatus, including components and open/closed/full states.

sources.name: Open Pain Illustration
sources.author: Yanick X. Lukic et al.
sources.rights_notes: Collect illustrations only. Keep paper citation and CC BY 4.0 attribution; SNOMED mappings/software are outside this artwork import.
sources.style_notes: Anterior/posterior anatomical body illustrations and region-colored variants for pain-location communication.

sources.name: NIH BioArt Source
sources.rights_notes: Official discover catalog enumerated 958 artworks, 930 Public Domain and 28 CC-BY abbreviations on 2026-11-06. The adapter reads exact Creative Commons version URIs from the 28 item Licensing anchors; only genuinely unresolved entries are held. Preserve creators and original license labels. Variants remain grouped by artwork ID; image downloads run in cloud CI.
sources.style_notes: Professional medical illustration with organs, animals, cells, equipment and molecular or cellular processes.

sources.name: Reactome Icon Library
sources.author: Reactome; individual designers and curators
sources.rights_notes: Official category pagination enumerated all 2571 declared unique icons in 112 metadata pages on 2026-11-06. Graphical material is CC BY 4.0; retain Reactome institutional credit. Category pages do not give individual designers: author remains unknown, not invented. Direct SVG/PNG validation runs in cloud CI. The obsolete bulk TGZ endpoint is unused.
sources.style_notes: Cellular and molecular pathway components, receptors, organelles and some organ/anatomy artwork.

sources.name: SciDraw
sources.rights_notes: Official API enumerated 755 SVG/PNG drawings: 142 CC0 and 613 cc-by. Official licensing page, upload selector and per-drawing attribution UI explicitly define cc-by as CC BY 4.0. Preserve per-item overrides, author, DOI and original label.
sources.style_notes: Contributor drawings with useful animals, organs, cell types and experimental setups; quality and style vary.

sources.name: SwissBioPics
sources.author: SwissBioPics / Swiss-Prot group, SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics
sources.rights_notes: Official help permits copying, redistribution and commercial use with attribution. Homepage inventory yielded 32 cells; file endpoints follow official cellzone.js api/image mapping. Actual images still require cloud validation.
sources.style_notes: Biological cell drawings with named subcellular locations and organism-aware structure.

sources.name: DBCLS Togo Picture Gallery
sources.author: DBCLS
sources.rights_notes: Current official API enumerated 2252 items on 2026-11-06, superseding the 539-item 2018 CSV. Preserve each artist, English/Japanese name, taxonomy, DOI and exact item license. Four API license fields contain .ai filenames; retain the original values and cite the explicit CC BY 4.0 collection license. Required credit: © 2016 DBCLS TogoTV / CC-BY-4.0. Four multi-color SVG variant ZIPs expand only in cloud CI; other originals are fetched directly from the official archive.
sources.style_notes: Life-science organism, anatomy and apparatus artwork with English/Japanese titles and taxonomy metadata.

sources.name: BioCartoon
sources.rights_notes: The catalog URL returned HTTP 403 after an earlier read. Do not retry or route around the blocked catalog. Database/CLI code BSD-2-Clause does not relicense constituent images. Existing source research can guide independent original-source adapters.
sources.style_notes: Multi-source scientific artwork aggregator plus own and contributor drawings; both genuine vectors and raster images are present.

sources.name: Servier Medical Art
sources.author: Servier Medical Art
sources.rights_notes: Keep on hold: official conditions on automated collection and standalone image-library distribution require source-specific resolution. Another site's mirror is not proof this use is cleared.
sources.style_notes: Consistent medical and anatomical illustrations, including editable PowerPoint artwork and PNG.

sources.name: IAN/UMCES Symbols
sources.author: IAN/UMCES and individual artists
sources.rights_notes: Collect relevant illustrations only and preserve artist attribution and share-alike requirements.
sources.style_notes: Ecology, environment, plants, animals and process artwork; useful for exposure and environmental-health topics.

sources.name: PhyloPic
sources.rights_notes: Licenses differ by image; select redistributable items and retain artist/phylogeny provenance.
sources.style_notes: Taxonomically organized organism silhouettes; good for species and cohort diagrams, not anatomical detail.

sources.name: OpenMoji
sources.author: OpenMoji contributors
sources.rights_notes: Preserve item authorship, source, license and modifications; source inclusion is not item acceptance.
sources.style_notes: General pictograms; select medical, people, diet and lifestyle illustrations only.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.rights_notes: Inspect exact file page, original source, creator, license and derivative conditions. Photos and study data figures are outside v1.
sources.style_notes: Mixed styles and quality; targeted discovery fills specific anatomy and procedure gaps.

sources.name: SciGlyph
sources.author: ZengZichao
sources.rights_notes: Artwork CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Mark declared AI-assisted origin and inspect scientific content. Its MCP sampleAssets implementation is not proof of complete library search.
sources.style_notes: AI-assisted and human-reviewed structured scientific SVGs with bilingual labels and multiple visual series.
